title: Piddington villagers vow ‘war isn’t over’ as Rayner approves MoD Bicester asylum camp for 1,256 men
summary_full: Piddington residents have vowed to continue their opposition after Angela Rayner approved plans to accommodate 1,256 male asylum seekers at the former military site, MoD Bicester. Despite the planning approval, villagers are considering legal action, insisting their fight is far from over. The Home Office says a final decision on the site's use is still pending.
